answer_1.quote: We conduct a series of AMT evaluations for the open‑ended problem of story generation ... We randomly select 200 prompts from the test set for all of our experiments.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation of model‑generated text ... is frequently conducted on Amazon's popular Mechanical Turk platform (AMT)... We perform a series of story generation evaluations with both AMT workers and expert raters (English teachers)... Workers were asked to rate human‑written and/or machine‑generated stories on four attributes ... Their ratings fall on a 5‑point Likert scale with the corresponding endpoints labelled as "lowest" (1 point) and "highest" (5 points).
answer_4.guideline: Rate each story on Grammar, Coherence, Likability, and Relevance using a 5‑point Likert scale.
